Remember Leopold Aschenbrenner and the implosion of his hedge fund, Situational Awareness?

Hedge fund managers are like cockroaches. When you find one running a particular strategy, you can be sure there are many more doing exactly the same thing.

I suspect we’re seeing a wave of hedge funds blowing up behind the scenes. The Nasdaq was an extremely crowded trade, and I believe much of the current drawdown is being driven by forced liquidations as leveraged funds unwind the same positions.

I don’t believe there’s any systemic risk to the financial system. And if the $VIX hits 30 because of an attack on Iran or a further Nasdaq drawdown, you can count on me shorting the shit out of $UVXY.
tweets.quoted_tweet_text:
While I don’t know what will happen in the next month, I can almost guarantee that six months from now you’ll look at oil prices and $VIX and say: that was such an obvious short.

$CL 110
$UVXY 61.5

tweets.text:
I’ve had a number of local Indians at Devcon approach me and thank me for running the online course ~~3-4 years ago as it was a means to help them start their crypto journey. 

It is really pleasant to gradually identify the  people who took advantage of the material across the world. 

More so, it does make me consider, that my research was probably not as impactful relative to my educational endeavours. 

That seems to be what has really helped people. 

Put another way, even if your immediate work does not appear to be have an impact, I’m pretty sure you’ll discover side adventures that will.

Meanwhile, one-year H100 contract prices are up ~21% since March 2026, with customers committing to pay those rates for a full year. This is the key metric that reflects the longer-term customer commitments that underpin GPU rental economics. (2/3)
